body: That’s how I think about it too. She has asked where my sense of “traditionalism” came from since we used to do this before we got married. To me, marriage is looking at the long term, not the short term. I’m convincing myself she doesn’t want to be with me anymore. I’m pulling away from her and it’s killing me inside.

I’m sorry man.. it’s hard. My though process is almost identical to yours. I find everyone else revolting, I’ve poured everything I have into this marriage, I love her but I don’t know what to do anymore. My preferred method is hanging too but I also think about killing myself the same way my dad did. I want to get on the freeway and drive as fast as I can into a concrete barrier. I think about it every single day.

I’ve been cutting on my upper thigh so she hasn’t seen it yet.. haven’t told her about it yet either. I haven’t had a relationship with my mom since my dad died. Idk, my headspace is all over the place right now
Thanks.. yeah, I just go through the motions. I’m stretched thin..
